text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-8421 triggered in escalation chain: SRE -> Eng Oncall -> Platform. Rule: inference-gateway >5xx-rate 3m window (eu-west1).
Maya Cunningham: seeing a flood of 502/504s in dashboard, error_rate jumped to ~12% at 12:06 UTC. Pager fired.
Raj Patel: acked PD-8421. I'm on it, grabbing logs.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8421 acknowledged by Raj Patel (oncall-sre). Next escalation suppressed for 15m.
Liam Ortiz: any recent deploys to gateway? I see a completed canary job 2m before the spike: `deploy/inference-gateway canary v2026.3`.
Sasha Chen: yep that canary rolled around 12:04. Telemetry shows sudden increase in backend connection errors and upstream timeouts.
Maya Cunningham: reproduction: curl to /v1/health returns 200, but production requests proxied to model-backend are timing out. Example 502 payloads: `{"error":"upstream read timeout"}`.
Raj Patel: pulling logs: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/inference-gateway -c gateway --since=5m | grep -E \"5..\" | head` -> shows many `upstream connection reset` and `read timeout`.
Liam Ortiz: metrics: `sum(rate(http_server_errors[1m])) by (region)` -> eu-west1 spike. Also connection sockets in CLOSE_WAIT for gateway pods are high.
Sasha Chen: possibility: keepalive settings from the canary changed, causing backend pool exhaustion. Can you confirm the canary's nginx/proxy config?
Raj Patel: checking canary config diff:
```
- proxy_http_version 1.1;
- proxy_set_header Connection "";
+ proxy_http_version 1.1;
+ proxy_set_header Connection keep-alive;
```
Raj Patel: looks like keepalive toggled on. That could leave sockets open if backends aren't handling keepalive.
Maya Cunningham: customer impact: a few high-volume customers reported increased error rates and retries; SLOs at risk for edge routes (latency counts also creeping up).
Liam Ortiz: immediate mitigation: roll back canary to previous config or restart gateway pods to clear connections. Which gives fastest reduction in errors? Sasha?
Sasha Chen: restart is fastest short-term. Rolling back is safer for the next deploy. I'll trigger rolling restart across pods with 30s stagger.
Raj Patel: running restart: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-gateway --timeout=5m` (stagger via script).
Maya Cunningham: pinging tier-1 customers via #support to notify about transient errors, set expectation: investigating, mitigation in progress.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8421 status: acknowledged; responders: Raj Patel (SRE), Sasha Chen (Platform), Maya Cunningham (Triage).
Liam Ortiz: after first pod restarted, error_rate dropped from 12% -> 6% within 45s. Rolling restart proceeding.
Sasha Chen: note: backend pool metrics show socket reclaim only after pod restart; this reinforces keepalive leak hypothesis.
Raj Patel: telemetry after full restart (3 pods): 5xx down to ~0.9% sustained. Latency normalized. Rolling restart appears to have mitigated.
Maya Cunningham: creating incident ticket and linking logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026
Sasha Chen: next steps: revert the canary change in config repo, add e2e test for connection reuse, and tweak keepalive defaults in backend service.
Liam Ortiz: I'll open a PR to revert the config and add a load test simulating keepalive churn.
Raj Patel: adding runbook entry: if 5xx spike with high CLOSE_WAIT counts, consider rolling restart + rollback canary.
Maya Cunningham: going to notify affected customers and update status page. PD: can be closed once 1h of stable metrics and postmortem scheduled.
incident-bot: Incident PD-8421 marked as mitigated by Raj Patel at 12:14 UTC; monitoring continues.
Sasha Chen: scheduling blameless postmortem for 15:00 UTC today. Invite: SRE, Platform, DevEx, Support.
Liam Ortiz: notes for postmortem:
- trigger: config change enabling keepalive during canary
- impact: transient 5xx spike -> customer retries/errors
- mitigation: rolling restart of gateway pods and rollback PR
- action items: revert config, add tests, update runbook, alert thresholds tuned
Maya Cunningham: thanks team. I'll keep thread updated if anything reappears. :thumbsup:
Raj Patel: closing PD once we have 60m stable window. Leaving monitoring alerts unmuted.
pagerduty-bot: PD-8421: awaiting closure. Last update logged by Raj Patel at 12:18 UTC.
Maya Cunningham: final check: dashboards show steady state for 12 minutes, no new errors. I'll post incident summary in #incidents-summary after the postmortem.
incident-bot: automated note: If any customer escalations arrive, tag with `INC-2026` and add to the postmortem comments.
Sasha Chen: added the runbook entry and the revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-config/pull/421
Liam Ortiz: will run the keepalive load test in staging later today and report results.
Maya Cunningham: thanks all — handing off to follow-up owners.
